posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Course VM is not available till 14th Dec.
This has been done to avoid further confusion among students.

14th December is not a normal slot for OPPE, rather a re-attempt for people who failed the first OPPE on 7th. No special concessions are made for the same.

If you want you can practice on your personal VMs as you like.

You can refer to the extra content posted on youtube.
